sceneConcept: A composed forty-five-year-old mixed-heritage warehouse-family adviser stands alone against a transparent background. Short dark brown hair greys at the temples, brown eyes sit behind thin gold-wire rectangular glasses, and his fingers are carefully groomed. He wears a cream collared shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, dark charcoal waistcoat, straight black trousers, a simple belt and polished brown shoes. He turns one plain cream cargo manifest from a small stack, exposing one small flat black eagle-emblem tattoo on his left inner forearm. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the page and tattoo readable. Visual refresh: refined dockside streetwear that exposes the forearm tattoo through asymmetrical rolled sleeves.
naturalLanguageDetail: A composed forty-five-year-old mixed-heritage warehouse adviser with thin gold-wire rectangular glasses turns one plain cream cargo manifest with long well-groomed fingers, exposing one small flat black eagle-emblem tattoo on his left inner forearm under soft even frontal studio light; refined dockside streetwear that exposes the forearm tattoo through asymmetrical rolled sleeves.
